summary: 10.5.0 deprecations: ngine_io.exoscale will be removed in Ansible 11 unless maintained, t_systems_mms.icinga_director is renamed to telekom_mms.icinga_director (old name removed in 11), and sensu.sensu_go will be removed in Ansible 12 for sanity test failures.
questions: What is the new collection name for icinga_director?
Is the exoscale collection being removed?
Why is sensu.sensu_go leaving the Ansible package?
When do I need to update my icinga_director FQCNs?

answer_card.title: Collection deprecations in 10.5.0
answer_card.answer_md:
- `ngine_io.exoscale`: deprecated, removed from Ansible 11 unless someone maintains it.
- `t_systems_mms.icinga_director` is renamed to `telekom_mms.icinga_director`. The old name has had only redirects since 9.0.0 and is removed in Ansible 11, so update your FQCNs.
- `sensu.sensu_go`: removed from Ansible 12 because of unresolved sanity test failures.
